column3: Full-body pure side view of H holding a forearm plank on the floor: forearms flat on the floor, elbows under shoulders, body perfectly straight from head to heels, exactly two legs, focused face.
Full-body front view of H standing straight for jumping jacks: feet together, arms down at his sides, happy energetic face.

Full-body pure side view of H doing a wall sit: back flat against a plain vertical wall, knees bent at 90 degrees, thighs parallel to the floor, arms crossed, straining face. The wall drawn as a simple vertical surface.
Full-body pure side view of H in a forward lunge: front knee bent at 90 degrees, back knee near the floor, torso upright, hands on hips, exactly two legs.
Full-body side view of H lying on his back doing a dead bug: arms reaching straight up to the ceiling, knees bent at 90 degrees above his hips, lower back pressed to the floor.
Full-body front view of H in the jump of a burpee: in the air, both arms straight up overhead, energetic face.
Full-body pure side view of H doing mountain climbers: high plank on straight arms, his right knee driven toward his chest, left leg straight back, exactly two legs.
Full-body pure side view of H lying on his back on the floor, knees bent, feet flat, arms by his sides, hips DOWN on the floor (start of a glute bridge).
Full-body pure side view of H walking on his tiptoes (heels high off the floor), arms swinging, proud funny face.

Full-body front view of H holding a big blank wall calendar page with both hands in front of his chest, grinning at the viewer. The calendar page is blank white with a red top strip, no numbers, no text.
